plugins.name: small-business-ai-rules
plugins.description: AI rules for a person or small business that runs on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Gemini subscriptions: which tool gets which job, what data may go where, how accounts are locked down, how AI-shaped decisions are logged, and how to pull the plug.

skills.name: ai-control-plane-solo
skills.description: Rules for a person or small business that uses AI only through chat subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, NotebookLM), not APIs: a tool routing table, four data classes, a dated account-settings checklist, a decision log, and an incident card. Use when the user asks for AI usage rules or an AI policy for themselves or a small team, asks whether specific business, customer, employee, financial, or regulated information may be pasted into an AI chat tool, asks which AI subscription should handle a recurring business job, or needs to respond after sensitive information went into an AI tool. Do not use for API, gateway, or enterprise AI governance, or for general feature or price comparisons of AI products.
headings: AI Control Plane, Solo and Small Team Edition
For a team of two to ten
Scaling up, when you want it
Sources this skill is built on
